title: Redesign the ai board as a dated list

set.tab: Redesign AI dashboard la… - monorepo - Visual Studio Code
set.request: the framework/ai/ dashboard should remove the paragraph at the top. all cards should be listed by date, one card per row, remove the grid. add a little h4 styled time declaration for current time, put active cards above, finished cards below. cards from past days should have a TUESDAY heading to it, instead of time of day. maybe add a little category tag to each, when clicked, use a dynamic route() to filter the list by that category? the status dot is misaligned, make it align top.
set.now: docs — readme, doc/file/board.js.md, and the four file docs the rework dated
steps: Read the board end to end
One card per row — the grid becomes a column
The dated list: active above, finished below, headings on change
The category tag on the card
route() filters the list by category
Align the status dot to the top
Verify at laptop and 3440 width, and update the docs
set.outcome: **The board is a time spine.** [/framework/ai/](/framework/ai/) — intro prose gone, the card grid replaced by one card per row, every card headed by its time (today) or its weekday (SATURDAY, and the date too past a week), active above, dormant below. Each card wears its effort as a tag linking to [/framework/ai/effort/<slug>/](/framework/ai/effort/ai-log/), a new route() that filters the same spine. Status dot now centres on the title's first line to the pixel. New file: ext/AITask/board.js; effort_groups() and dots() deleted — a running task is listed once, not pinned over a duplicate.
